task_title: reference를 포함한 R/T/A, 복소 S, phase/group delay, mode decomposition, diffraction, far-field/near-zone을 기존 결과와 통합한다

physics_configuration.module: torchfdtd.results: ResultRecord, reflection_transmission, s_parameters, mode_decomposition, diffraction_record, farfield_record, nearzone_record
physics_configuration.slab_flux: tests/test_field_monitors.py::slab_project (2D, 8 x 0.5 um, mesh 0.025 um, 1600 steps, float64, periodic y, n = 1.5 slab 0.2 um thick, reflection monitor at x = -0.8 um, transmission at +0.8 um, 31 frequencies) plus two y-normal faces at y = +-0.2 um closing a box; the same monitor set for the sample, the empty reference and a lossy slab (Lorentz pole 1.2e15 rad/s, 4e29 rad^2/s^2, 8e14 rad/s, epsilon_inf 2.25)
physics_configuration.straight_guide: tests/test_mode_branches.py::straight_project at 600 steps, aperture ports at x = +-1 um, carriers 1.5, 1.55 and 1.6 um; the fundamental mode of the 2.4 x 0.5 um cell from solve_waveguide_modes
physics_configuration.y_branch: tests/test_mode_branches.py::branch_project, ybranch_ports, ybranch_sections, ybranch_epsilon at one carrier (1.55 um)
physics_configuration.slab_guide: benchmarks/mode_injection.py::make_case('slab', steps=600), modal launch and the far plane at 1.55 um
physics_configuration.grating: tests/test_physics_g3_b.py::grating_project(0.03 um, TE, 20 deg, 1.02 um, duration 150 fs) with and without the ridge: the G3-08 geometry at a coarse mesh for the interface, not the RCWA comparison
physics_configuration.dipole: tests/test_radiation.py::dipole_faces(10) analytic dipole in n = 1.3 on a closed box; a Rayleigh plane as the incident reference

reference_method: Fabry-Perot transmission of the n = 1.5 slab; the balance 1 - R - T against the closed-box absorption of the lossy slab; the Yee longitudinal wavenumber (2/h) asin(beta h / 2) of the mode solver's beta for the group delay; the existing public functions (normalize_flux, modal_plane_amplitudes, diffraction_orders, project_farfield, project_nearzone) for the values the records wrap

observables.name: R_T_balance
observables.definition: record['R'], ['T'], ['balance'] of the lossless slab against the reference run

observables.name: A_vs_balance
observables.definition: record['A'] from the four box faces of the lossy slab against record['balance']

observables.name: group_delay_s
observables.definition: record['group_delay_s'][1, 1, 0] of the straight-guide S21 sweep

observables.name: forward_fraction
observables.definition: mode_decomposition forward_fraction on the far plane of the slab guide

observables.name: efficiency_sum
observables.definition: sum of the valid transmitted and reflected order efficiencies of the coarse grating

observables.name: units
observables.definition: record.units and record.calibration of every named value

acceptance_limits.slab: T and R within 0.004 of the Fabry-Perot formula and its complement; |1 - R - T| below 0.004; A not measured with the reason; the lossy slab's A above 0.02 and within 0.01 of the balance
acceptance_limits.s_parameters: the FDTD group delay is positive and within 3 percent of 2 um * d beta_yee / d omega, and between 1.2 and 1.35 times the continuum value at this mesh; the reflection channels have no phase (magnitude floor); the single-carrier Y branch has |S21| = |S31| within 1e-3 and no group delay with the three-frequency reason
acceptance_limits.modes: forward fraction between 0.9 and 1.15; backward fraction below 0.02 or flagged weak
acceptance_limits.diffraction: orders -1 and 0 propagating and valid at 1.02 um and 20 deg with period 1.2 um; orders -2, 1, 2 evanescent with NaN efficiency and the reason; transmitted plus reflected efficiencies within 0.05 of 1 at the coarse mesh; a synthetic order at cutoff refuses
acceptance_limits.radiation: reduced intensity positive on 56 directions; the normalized intensity equals the reduced one over the reference flux magnitude to 1e-10; a zero reference refuses; the near-zone record carries the six fields and the Poynting vector in reduced units
acceptance_limits.units: ratios are 'dimensionless' with calibration 'dimensionless ratio to the matched reference run'; fluxes carry the record's flux_units with calibration 'reduced'; group delay is 's'; positions 'um'
acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: completion_gates.json proposed_thresholds slab_R_T_absolute_error (0.01, tightened to 0.004 by the existing slab test) and lossless_complete_channel_balance_absolute_error (0.01); the group-delay, fraction and coarse-grating budgets are fixture-specific and declared here before the run

applicable_scope: CPU only: 2D float64 slab and grating runs, float32 mode-port fixtures (straight guide, Y branch, slab guide), analytic dipole faces; no CUDA instance re-recorded on aa3f8c1506b5 for the release candidate.
